title: Anatomy of a Whisker's Soul - Vergrim
description: Anatomy of a Whisker's Soul - Vergrim — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill Vergrim's Vengeful Soul in Vergrim's Revenge off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section in Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag to collect Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel then return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Collecting Souls of Whiskers Past

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Vergrim's Vengeful Soul in Vergrim's Revenge off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section in Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag to collect Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel then return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Now we have two Soul crystals and the last one we need is Vergrim's Soul. It is hard to believe that any of these Whiskers actually had souls, but then again who thought Rotgut was once a dashing Rock and Roll star?! We live in strange times, Dungeon Runner. However, things are about to get better once you get your hands on that crystal.

Go to Vergrim's Revenge off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section in Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay Vergrim's Ghost. Next slay Vergrim's Vengeful Soul to get Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel to drop. Collect Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel and return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

You have the crystal? Vergrim's Soul? You really are one of the greats, Dungeon Runner!

Objectives:

  • Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel ×1

Client level range: 81–100
